meta_description: PSD Electrical in Liverpool provides reliable domestic and commercial electrical work. Fast response times, fully qualified team. Call 07790 806569 today.
hero_subhead: Fault finding, rewires, and installations handled by experienced electricians. We're here when you need us most.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full house rewires, we handle domestic and commercial work with precision and care.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Tripped circuits, dead sockets, and faulty switches fixed fast. We carry common parts on the van and aim to solve most faults the same day.

services.title: Full House & Property Rewires
services.desc: Modern wiring installations that improve safety and add capacity for modern appliances. We manage the whole project from testing to certification.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Can't find the fault? We use diagnostic equipment to trace intermittent faults and faulty circuits without unnecessary trial and error.

services.title: Consumer Unit & Fuseboard Upgrades
services.desc: Outdated fuseboards replaced with modern, safe consumer units. Better protection for your home and compatibility with RCDs and circuit breakers.

services.title: Lighting & Socket Installation
services.desc: New lights, outdoor sockets, and socket relocations positioned exactly where you need them. All work tested and certified.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Electrical
services.desc: Office rewires, factory installations, and maintenance contracts. We understand compliance and keep your business running safely.

about_pullquote: We answer our phone at 6am because real electrical emergencies don't wait.
about_para_1: PSD Electrical has been serving Liverpool and Merseyside homes and businesses for 18 years. Founded on the principle that good electrical work is reliable work, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing problems accurately, and charging fairly. Every member of the team is qualified to current Building Regulations, and we're registered with NICEIC.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we fix things properly the first time and we're honest about what needs doing. Whether it's a 3am emergency or a planned rewire, we approach every job with the same care. We're local, we know Liverpool inside out, and we genuinely care about keeping your home and business safe.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: House had a complete rewire done in 2022. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished on schedule. Three years on, everything still works perfectly. Highly recommend PSD.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Electrical fault at midnight before New Year. Called PSD and they were at my door within the hour. Diagnosed a faulty consumer unit and sorted it that night. Saved the day. Cheers lads.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Extension electrics were a nightmare until I called PSD. They tested, identified what was wrong, and rewired it safely. Fair price, no nonsense, no pressure selling. Exactly what you want from a tradesperson.
reviews.author: Sarah L.
